_readme: Mapping constants for the DustCar rig. Every number carries its provenance.
verified=false means PLACEHOLDER: computed targets from it are not trustworthy
until it is measured on the real hardware. Nothing here is a team standard.
fx/fy are the same simulation defaults used by the phone-vision-arm rig model;
they are NOT a real intrinsics measurement.

frame_width_px.source: 1080p assumption; confirm the phone stream size

frame_height_px.source: 1080p assumption; confirm the phone stream size

default_height_mm.source: placeholder subject size; the App must supply the real one per shot

default_speed_pct.source: conservative placeholder for a tabletop subject

mm_per_s_at_100pct.source: PLACEHOLDER: measure on the floor, speed=100, tape measure over >=1s

dir_close.source: PLACEHOLDER: which dir reduces camera-subject distance

column.note: alternative for center_y or for height changes; not used unless remapped

pan.source: PLACEHOLDER: confirm id, direction sign and gear ratio on the gimbal

tilt.source: PLACEHOLDER: confirm id, direction sign and gear ratio on the gimbal

safe_min_angle.source: PLACEHOLDER: mechanical limit, confirm before live motion

safe_max_angle.source: PLACEHOLDER: mechanical limit, confirm before live motion

column.source: PLACEHOLDER: GT2-20T belt = 40mm/rev guess; confirm id and direction

min_action_ms.source: below this a move is not worth sending

max_run_seconds.source: adapter guard, not a firmware limit

max_correction_mm.source: safety placeholder: biggest dolly one visual correction may command

max_correction_deg.source: safety placeholder: biggest joint move one visual correction may command

min_correction_interval_s.source: safety placeholder: settle time between corrections
